settings.question: Is Brant Business Interiors a Humanscale dealer?
settings.answer: Yes. Brant Business Interiors is an authorized Humanscale dealer serving Ontario. We supply, quote, deliver, and install the Humanscale lines we carry — height-adjustable sit-stand desks and LED task lighting — for institutional and workplace clients, with delivery and installation by our own Ontario crew.

settings.question: Which Humanscale products does Brant Business Interiors carry?
settings.answer: We carry Humanscale height-adjustable sit-stand desking and LED task lighting, including the eFloat sit-stand desk and the Nova task light. We confirm current model availability, finish, and configuration on every quote. For other Humanscale products, ask us — as an authorized dealer we can quote across the catalogue.

settings.question: What is the lead time on Humanscale orders?
settings.answer: Lead time depends on the model, finish, and configuration. Because Humanscale products are specified to order, we confirm the exact lead time on your quote before your purchase order is issued. Call 1-800-835-9565 or request a quote and we will respond in one business day.

settings.question: Do you deliver and install Humanscale across Ontario?
settings.answer: Yes. Brant Business Interiors delivers and installs across Ontario with our own team — sit-stand desks set up and levelled, task lighting fitted and tested. We coordinate the schedule with your site contact, with no third-party freight handoff.

settings.question: Are Humanscale products available to OECM buyers?
settings.answer: Brant Business Interiors is registered under our parent legal entity, Brant Basics, as an authorized OECM Supplier Partner. Eligible Ontario broader-public-sector buyers — school boards, hospitals, and municipalities — can purchase office furniture and installation from us without an open tender. Family-owned and supplying Ontario workplaces since 1964, from 701 The Queensway, Units 2-4, Peterborough, ON K9J 7J6.
